maneuvers.instruction: Point yer bow southwest and set sail on Carrer Doctor Nequí.
maneuvers.verbal_succinct_transition_instruction: Set sail southwest. Then, in 400 feet, Make a sharp left onto Avinguda del Princep Benlloch ye scallywag.

maneuvers.verbal_succinct_transition_instruction: Make a sharp left bucko. Then Blimey! Ye will arrive at yer destination.
